title: First exponential improvement for diagonal Ramsey numbers since 1935

items.title_found: An exponential improvement for diagonal Ramsey
items.meta_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2303.09521: An exponential improvement for diagonal Ramsey
passages: This is the first exponential improvement over the upper bound of Erdős and Szekeres, proved in 1935.
The Ramsey number $R(k)$ is the minimum $n \in \mathbb{N}$ such that every red-blue colouring of the edges of the complete graph $K_n$ on $n$ vertices contains a monochromatic copy of $K_k$.

passages: In a recent breakthrough Campos, Griffiths, Morris and Sahasrabudhe obtained the first exponential improvement of the upper bound on the diagonal Ramsey numbers since 1935.
We shorten their proof, replacing the underlying book algorithm with a simple inductive statement.
